steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll repeat again, so listen up. 'My wish is to join the L.G.D., and from there, I'll join the Special Inspection Unit.'

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I will protect this city, and I'll clean this place up. There won't be another incident like that.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...But we are ready to make headways in the slums. There's also that housing plan for the Infected, ready to be launched. Wouldn't you say we're in a better shape than before?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We are more than ready to treat all the Infected fairly and equally. We will give everyone in Lungmen a fair treatment regardless of whether they are Infected or not, because they are all people of Lungmen!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Sure, we may be ready, but is Lungmen ready? Are the masses ready? Will the Chamber of Commerce vote for it? What do you think will happen if I tell the L.G.D. that I'm Infected?
Nine, you knew right from the start that I was never going to succeed.
And so, why help me?
Ch'en... Superintendent Ch'en...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Well, what a surprise. I sure didn't expect to find Superintendent Ch'en, our department's proud workaholic, faffing about here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Swire, you should be standing by on the outskirts of the slums.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm just about done there. It's why I'm here to give you a holler.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What happened to using comms? Pretty sure you get a decent signal in the slums.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I wanted to see you cry your heart out with my own eyes.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Stop trying to hide it, Ch'en Hui-chieh. Nine was your cheerleader. You always counted on her having your back, and the new Infected housing plan was the one thing weighing on your mind all this year.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And now, Nine's resigned, and the bill didn't pass. What do you think I mean?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: She's not my cheerleader.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And I suppose neither is Chief Wei, hm?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You were a fresh face with an empty file, barely on the job for two years before breaking the record for fastest promotion to the Special Inspection Unit. And then you became the strongest proponent of the new Infected housing plan.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Looks like you hold a real grudge against me for beating you on the entrance exams. Seems the princess of the Schwire family doesn't have much patience.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hmph, I admit my skills are no match for yours.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I certainly didn't expect that, outside the L.G.D., the first time I heard someone mention your name would be at a party, though.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Miss Ch'en Hui-chieh, do you know why?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: It was that bill.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: They said that it was like you thought you had free rein to do whatever you wanted because both Chief Wei and Nine had your back.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Then they clinked their glasses, self-satisfyingly joked about how full of yourself you are, and went off on their merry way.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm full of myself...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Right, that's what they thought of all the hard work you poured into this. They didn't even mention you again.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And if you're still planning on faffing about here, let me tell you that the other thing you've been planning for so long—sending the L.G.D. into the slums—won't ever happen.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: We have several squads ready, but Nine is gone. You're the leader now, and everyone is waiting on you.

a.text: But what if I am wrong?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't need you to tell me what to do.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I should certainly hope not.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Missy, how come you didn't tell her about the part where you walked up and threw your wine in their faces?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm not here to console her or talk about our common enemy. I'm here to laugh in her face.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And she's the one in charge of today's operation. Am I supposed to lead this thing for her, if she can't get her arse moving?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You don't think she did anything wrong, though, am I right?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Since I was little, I've seen a lot of people try to put on an act for my grandfather, like they're trying to accomplish something big.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Most of them were phony, though. All in it for the money.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: He must be very insightful, then.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I have no idea how insightful he is, but it's thanks to him that I can tell when someone's putting on a show.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So what about Ch'en?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Her?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Completely clueless.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Haha, can't deny that.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Let's go. We've got lots to do today.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Superintendent Ch'en, the establishment of L.G.D. offices in the slums marks a big day.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Could you share how you're feeling right now?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Policeman A
steps.text: Out of the way.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Hey, no pushing!

steps.name: Policeman A
steps.text: Oops, no idea where that one came from.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Didn't I say to keep the reporters away?

steps.name: Policeman A
steps.text: We tried, Superintendent Ch'en, but the L.G.D. setting up shop in the slums is a big deal. There's no way to keep all the flies out.

steps.name: Policeman B
steps.text: They're all waiting for us to embarrass ourselves.

steps.name: Policeman B
steps.text: Uh... I'm not saying there's anything wrong with the plan. It's just, Nine quit all of a sudden, and you are one of the proponents of the Infected housing plan. Things are going to get intense.

a.text: The Infected housing plan, the L.G.D. moving into the slums. They're the talk of the town.
Like the hottest new toys in the shops.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Let them take their pictures.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Get in formation.

steps.name: Policemen
steps.text: Here!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The slums have always been a sore spot for the L.G.D.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The slums are run by criminals, the slums are home to the Infected, and the slums are outside the law... The slums are a problem for Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I know that a lot of you don't understand why we're here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But I must say this. Those of us who live in the urban districts must take some responsibility for how things turned out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's because we've never treated the slums as a part of Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: From this day forward, we will show the people here, by way of our actions, that they are part of Lungmen, and Lungmen will treat them as equals.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Is that understood?

steps.name: Policemen
steps.text: Understood!

a.text: I can hear them gossip amongst themselves.
Is it because my conviction is not firm enough?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Everything aside, I don't know whether we see the slum dwellers as equals, but there are certain people out there who definitely treat us as equals.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Wherever we are and whatever it is we're doing, trouble will always find us.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And since today's our grand opening in the slums, you know those friends of ours who don't see eye to eye with us? We'll definitely get a surprise gift from them.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No need to think too much about it, folks. If they come, we'll take care of them.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And I'll take you all out to dinner when we're done.

steps.name: Policeman A
steps.text: What are we eating?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Whatever they serve at the dai pai dongs.

steps.name: Policemen
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If you guys can convince Ch'en to pitch in, we might go a little more upscale. Am I right, Ch'en?

steps.name: Policeman B
steps.text: Superintendent Ch'en, what do you say?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Haha, that's what I'm talking about.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Who is it?
Superintendent Ch'en. Your boy Ah Faat is here with us. If you don't want anything to happen to him, come alone.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where?
Such a quick response. I should've expected no less from you, Superintendent Ch'en.
Make your way to the location you just received. If we do not see you there in half an hour, I'm afraid Ah Faat won't make it out of this alive.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's the matter, Ch'en?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Trouble just found us.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Need me to come with you?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No. I can deal with them myself. You have command here.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Everyone, it's time to clean up.

steps.name: Policemen
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm here. Alone. No one else's coming.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Superintendent Ch'en...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ah Ah Faat, is it just you here?

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Deoi m zyu, Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You sold me out, huh?

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: The dai lo of the Anchors told me to hide here and blow you up. If I don't, they'll kill my mother.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: They know you're the one who cares the most about this L.G.D. in the slums thing, and that it'll all fall apart once they take you out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You'll lose your hand before you can press the button.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't do anything stupid.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: I don't have the remote, and even if you kill me, the guys outside will set the bombs off. You're the one who shouldn't do anything stupid, Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Why you...

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Don't blame me.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: I've known you were good ever since Madame Oni introduced us. Some of the other guys in the slums know it too, but most don't.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: You knew the triad bosses here wouldn't just sit by and let the L.G.D. waltz into their territory.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: What you don't know, though, is that even the normal folks who live here don't believe the L.G.D. is moving into the slums for any good reason.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: They think they're here to take our last bit of freedom away.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I didn't mean...

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: I know that isn't what you had in mind.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: But they don't.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Please, I'm begging you, Superintendent Ch'en.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: You're a good person. I don't want anything to happen to you.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Send a message out, and tell the ah sirs outside to pack up and never come back.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Bringing the L.G.D. into the slums isn't going to do any of us any good.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Even if you make it through today, you won't make it through tomorrow.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: You know how ruthless the dai los are. The methods they'll use to chase out the L.G.D. will turn your stomach!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Did you think... I'd just say 'okay'?

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: I followed Madame Oni for so long. I just want to turn over a new leaf myself, Superintendent!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Don't force my hand.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: An explosion? I didn't...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Get down!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Gah, is it the Anchors?!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Watch out, Ch'en. It's the...

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Ch'en? Ch'ennn!

a.text: Nine, is everything I'm doing here actually meaningless?
Am I just a joke to you?

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: She's still breathing. She's just unconscious.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: She probably got hurt shielding me. What should I do? What am I supposed to tell Madame Oni if something happens to Superintendent Ch'en...?

steps.name: Infected Thug
steps.text: What's to tell? You're both dying here.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: You... You're with the Anchors... Didn't we agree I'd do this myself?!

steps.name: Infected Thug
steps.text: The dai lo doesn't trust you. That's why we're here.

steps.name: Infected Thug
steps.text: Didn't we agree to blow her up the moment she steps inside? What are you doing here, having a nice little chat with her, hm?

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Ch'en isn't that gullible. I was trying to lure her somewhere I knew she'd get caught in the explosion.

steps.name: Infected Thug
steps.text: Is that so? Then how come she's lying on the ground, right after I pressed the button without a second thought?

steps.name: Infected Thug
steps.text: Go, see if she's dead yet.

steps.name: Infected Henchman
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Infected Thug
steps.text: Not so fast, Lee Bo-faat. Don't forget, we've got your mother.

steps.name: Infected Henchman
steps.text: She just passed out.

steps.name: Infected Thug
steps.text: She's not dead? Whatever, take her back and let the dai lo deal with her.

steps.name: Infected Henchman
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Infected Thug
steps.text: Who is it?! Who dares step up against the Anchors?!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Well, I have to hand it to you people. You've got some nerve, trying to rub out an L.G.D. Special Inspection Unit officer in broad daylight.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I wonder if people might talk about the Rat King keeping his own men in check, if word about this got out.

steps.name: Infected Thug
steps.text: Miss Lin! Th-This isn't what it looks like. Our boss's just inviting Superintendent Ch'en over for tea.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Then let Brother Sam know that the Rat King is inviting Superintendent Ch'en to tea as well. If Brother Sam wants her company, he needs to go through the Rat King first.

steps.name: Infected Thug
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I don't mind wiping the floor with the lot of you and telling him myself, either.

steps.name: Infected Thug
steps.text: Okay, okay, we get it! She's all yours!

steps.name: Infected Thug
steps.text: Let's go!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Miss Lin...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Your mother is fine. Don't worry.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Thank you!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: But Superintendent Ch'en...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You don't need to worry about her. I'm actually bringing her to see the Rat King. That said...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What a pathetic sight, Ch'en Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: So you're going back to become a cop?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: A cop?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Wow. I always thought you had the look of a girl who could give a good beating to a hooligan. I've got a gift!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're getting ahead of yourself. But the police...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's not a bad idea.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It'd probably be a great place to pick up clues about what happened back then, and what's happening now... I wouldn't have to rely on my old schemer of an uncle.

a.text: Back in Victoria, I studied a lot. I got the highest marks in every single subject. I barely had any fun at all.
I didn't want to rely on him.
But am I relying on him, after all?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: How did she...?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: *Sigh*... This, too, is fate. I've informed Wei Yenwu already.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Dad, this is nothing but trouble. Are you sure you want to bring her under your protection?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Even if she wasn't Yenwu's niece, I would've done the same. Consider what she's been doing for the slums the past couple years.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: She doesn't know what she's doing. She thinks this will make things better.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: She's certainly not going to turn them worse. In fact, things could actually improve.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I would've been much smarter about it.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But could you honestly do any better?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Now go. You've stuck your hands in this. Might as well lend one to the L.G.D.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: And go knock some sense into Ah Sam.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Err...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where am I...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Uncle Lin?!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Don't be so surprised. I sent you help, after all.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where's Ah Faat?!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: He's fine, and so is his mother.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: The L.G.D.'s moving into the slums. I suppose you won't blame me for not interfering?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I understand your position. I'm actually very thankful that you've stepped back.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Hohoh. Lungmenites all say Ch'en Hui-chieh is a stubborn one. The way I see it, you just don't want to bend to them.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Thank you for the compliment.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If I had the time, I would love to continue our conversation, but I'm still on a mission for the L.G.D., so please...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Oh, you can't go just yet.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And why not...?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Hui-chieh, you know my history with Wei Yenwu, so I'll call you Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Normally, an explosion of that size would not have knocked you out.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Do you know why you fainted?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Because... there was too much going on in my mind. I couldn't react in time.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: That's part of it, but there's another reason...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Do you know you're Infected?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I'm sorry I couldn't protect you, Ch'en.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: My crystals blocked most of it, but some shrapnel got through. I'm guessing some of it hit you... am I right? Let's take it quick. You might still make it out of this.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's when it happened.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No wonder I haven't been able to exert much strength lately.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: It was both the physiological changes brought on by Oripathy and your burnout. You've long been a ticking time bomb. All the explosion did was trigger that bomb along with it.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I've already sent someone to help the L.G.D. and inform them what happened. You needn't worry.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: We don't get the chance often. Come take a walk with an old man, Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Slum Child
steps.text: Miss Ch'en!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ah Lam? Oh... School's out already, isn't it?

steps.name: Slum Child
steps.text: Yep!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Have you been keeping up in school?

steps.name: Slum Child
steps.text: Yep! You told me to study hard, and I listened!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Good girl.

steps.name: Slum Child
steps.text: I'm taking my brother to lunch now. Come visit us next time. I'll tell you all about the things I learned.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You've been paying for the education of some two dozen children with your own salary.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You even spend time offering them guidance and wisdom after work.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Most are outstanding kids, much thanks to you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's what I should do.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Hui-chieh, if it wasn't for everything you've done in the slums the past two years, I wouldn't have come see you, and you would never have met the Rat King.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You can walk with me today because you're pushing the new Infected housing plan. Because you're moving the L.G.D. into the slums, to assimilate them into Lungmen.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Not because you're Wei Yenwu's niece, or because he taught you how to wield Chi Xiao, much less because you graduated from the Victorian Royal Guard Academy.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: No matter what Wei Yenwu thinks, I'll tell you this. You've done well.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Infected Slum Dweller
steps.text: Superintendent Ch'en, what are you doing here, chumming it up with the Rat King?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: She's just taking a walk with an old man.

steps.name: Infected Slum Dweller
steps.text: Oh, I see...

steps.name: Infected Slum Dweller
steps.text: Right, Superintendent Ch'en. The Oripathy suppressant you gave me last time really feels like it's working. I felt much better the last time I had a flare up.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's good. I...

steps.name: Infected Slum Dweller
steps.text: Don't tell me you'll bring me more. There's no way I can repay you.

steps.name: Infected Slum Dweller
steps.text: I probably won't ever be able to repay you for the ones you've already brought me.

steps.name: Infected Slum Dweller
steps.text: I'll just ration them.

steps.name: Infected Slum Dweller
steps.text: Oh, Superintendent Ch'en, I heard the housing plan didn't pass. Don't let it get to you. I figured it was an uphill battle from the beginning.

steps.name: Infected Slum Dweller
steps.text: A lot of people in the slums think it's all just a crowd-pleasing trick. They think you promoted a cause you knew was never going to happen just to earn yourself some fame. I don't think so, though.

steps.name: Infected Slum Dweller
steps.text: You helped me. I know you're doing this because you truly care for us, and I know it must really weigh on you.

steps.name: Infected Slum Dweller
steps.text: I heard the L.G.D. was moving into the slums today. I wanted to tell you this, and I figured I'd maybe run into you. I didn't actually expect to see you here, though.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Infected Slum Dweller
steps.text: Don't thank me. I'm the one who should thank you.

steps.name: Infected Slum Dweller
steps.text: I gotta head to the construction site for work. I'll see you later.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Take care of yourself.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: There are plenty of Infected who accepted your kindness.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Their lives are a little better than the other Infected, but there's a limit to how much better things can be.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Which is why I want to change something about all this, on a fundamental level.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Hui-chieh, Lungmen is a great city, don't you think?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Compared to some other places I know, it's a decent place.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But I wouldn't call it a great place.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Because you think it could be even better.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: And I feel the same when I look at you.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But there is only one Ch'en Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You want to convince me.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: What is there for me to convince? The road ahead is yours to choose yourself.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: That said, your road isn't Lungmen's or the L.G.D.'s. It's not Yenwu's either.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You have those who believe that you, Ch'en Hui-chieh, are a kindhearted person that treats the Infected well. But how are you going to make them believe in the daughter of the Schwire family?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I have had some dealings with Hoshiguma, and I can't even vouch for her, much less the officers who work for you.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You say you want fundamental change, but that is not something you can accomplish on your own.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: How will you persuade others to believe what you represent? How will you make them believe that what you represent has the strength you believe it does, Hui-chieh?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: This way.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Superintendent Ch'en!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ah Faat?!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: I... I'm sorry, Superintendent Ch'en.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: This is all my fault.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No, it's not.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: I'm glad you're alright. I wouldn't know how to face Madame Oni.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Same goes for you.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: But really, Superintendent Ch'en, everything I said to you, I meant every word.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: The L.G.D. shouldn't have come. You're not going to accomplish anything.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: It's still too early to shine a light on the slums.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Rat King, what's the meaning of this?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: It's very simple.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: No matter the case, he helped the Anchors, and it got you hurt.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You don't know it, but he's connected to several gangs here.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Take him with you, and you will actually learn quite a lot from him.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But I cannot allow the L.G.D. to take one of my boys before my very eyes.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Otherwise, how would I ever be able to face my friends?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: That's why you must make a decision now, Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: If you take Ah Faat with you, then we never took this walk together today.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You are free to continue your life as an upstanding citizen.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: If you don't take Ah Faat, you can leave the L.G.D. and come work for me.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You might remember my daughter, Yüshia. She could use someone her age, someone she can get along with, someone to help her out. I'm sure she'd be happy to see you too.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lin Yühsia... I'm not so sure about that.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You needn't worry. I'll sort things out with Yenwu.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are you... recruiting me?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Will Yenwu let an Infected stay in the L.G.D.?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You don't have many options, Hui-chieh.

a.text: I understand the Infected predicament well enough.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sir, I am referring to the incident that took place roughly ten years ago when the city was infiltrated by foreign forces. Several Lungmen citizens were kidnapped, and they are yet to be found.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I will continue to push the city to investigate and locate the missing citizens after my admission to the department.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Ch'en... You have no idea what you are talking about.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sir, I am perfectly aware of what I am talking about.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I won't argue. How about this, then? As soon as you don't think you can keep it up, just let me know.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Tell me, Superintendent Ch'en. How long do you want to be in the department?

a.text: Is this as far as I can go?
I haven't found her, and I haven't done anything to make this city a better place.
Is it really okay to give up like this?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I won't take Ah Faat in. He didn't mean to hurt me.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Superintendent Ch'en...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But let's forget we took this walk together.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You can drop the act. Since you saved me, I'm sure Wei Yenwu already knows that I'm Infected.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's only a matter of whether I tell him about it myself.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Hohoh, things aren't quite so transparent between me and Yenwu.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Though it's true that this isn't an easy thing to hide.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't know what he thinks, but if I can stay in the L.G.D., I will keep doing my job.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If I can't, I'll find another way.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm sure there is a lot that I could accomplish working for you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But that is not my way.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: No need to apologize, Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You aren't willing to give up yet. I won't say this is a good thing, as the path you have chosen is one without a future.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But you're still young. You have time to figure things out.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, Ch'en, are you okay there?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma? I'm fine. Just ran into a situation.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Okay, looks like Missy's friend wasn't pulling our leg.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: We're almost done over here. As for our next step, though. That's for you to decide.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm on my way.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Thank you for everything, Uncle Lin.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: No need to thank me. Thank yourself.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Look, Yenwu. It's like you two are both cut from the same cloth.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: That's not a good thing.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Now you say this is not a good thing.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I'm curious. Can an Infected run this city?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: If that's what she wants to do, I'm sure she can.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: There are certain things you should tell her yourself.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: If I told her myself, she wouldn't listen.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: That doesn't sound like something an elder who pushed all his arrangements back the moment he heard his niece was Infected would say.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: If you don't do something about yourself soon, she will never understand you.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It's not me that she doesn't understand. It's the rules, the shackles.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And since she doesn't have the strength to break free of them, she won't ever need to understand me.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Yet you hope she has that strength, and you're forging the sharpest blade for her. A blade called Lungmen.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: We walked all those years together, smiling until the very end, Kojui.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But do any of us really want anyone to repeat the same mistakes we made?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I taught her how to wield a blade, but, in the end, she must wield it herself.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: She needs to learn for herself how wield it. That is the only way the cloud-splitting sword she masters can be different from mine.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Her swordhand should not be the same as this one.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Fate. This is all fate.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: All the things we fought so hard for, they're all being destroyed before we even have the chance to enjoy them.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You gave Hui-chieh the greatest gift in the world, yet her time is already ticking away.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Heaven certainly knows how to play a cruel trick. Wouldn't you agree, Old Wei?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: What Heaven says or does means nothing to me.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But Lungmen will be a more perfect place. That is all I can do right now.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: See, that is why I say you are cut from the same cloth.
During the L.G.D.'s first attempt to move into the slums, Ch'en took the opportunity to sweep out several triad elements that had been hiding there.
That is why Ch'en was promoted to Chief of the Special Inspection Unit.
But right when everyone thought the L.G.D. had found its footing in the slums, Ch'en unexpectedly announced the L.G.D.'s retreat from the area.
Most thought their entrance a risky move she took to facilitate the surprise operation that followed.
Half a year later...

steps.name: Policeman A
steps.text: Where's Superintendent Ch'en? I got a letter for her.

steps.name: Policeman B
steps.text: She went back into her office after pouring another cup of Joe.

steps.name: Policeman A
steps.text: Still not going home, huh? What a workaholic.

steps.name: Policeman B
steps.text: You said it. Ever since that operation six months ago, she's been pushing herself way too hard.

steps.name: Policeman A
steps.text: If she keeps this up, it's really going to wear her out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What are you two gossiping about?

steps.name: Policeman A
steps.text: Oh, Superintendent Ch'en. It's nothing. Here's a letter for you, by the way.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: A letter? Let's see...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (It's from Nine?!)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (She... She started working with the Reunion Movement after she got infected?!)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (There's even a number on here...)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Reunion...)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hello... It's me.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: It's been a long time, Ch'en.
